newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche shares up seven pct in bourse.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche shares up seven pct in bourse.

text.p: Shares in Germany's largest commercial bank Deutsche Bank AG surged seven percent in early bourse trading compared with Tuesday's late price after first half 1997 figures exceeded analysts' expectations.
By 0900 GMT, Deutsche shares stood at 129.50 marks, up 8.50 marks or 7.0 percent, having earlier reached a high of 134.30 marks. It had ended IBIS computer trade on Tuesday at 121 marks.
The overall DAX index was also on record turf, up 3.60 percent at 4,383.98
Deutsche's group net income rose 27.5 percent to 1.5 billion marks in the six months to June 30. Analysts had expected the figure to be around 1.36 billion marks.
